task.name: pick_pepsi_transfer_place_plate_ep1
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the Pepsi can, transfer it to the right arm and then use the right arm to place it upright on the green plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the Pepsi can.
2. Grasp the Pepsi can with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to a transfer position.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the Pepsi can held by the left arm.
5. Grasp the Pepsi can with the right arm.
6. Release the Pepsi can from the left arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the green plate.
8. Release the gripper to place the Pepsi can upright on the green plate.
